messages.subject: Save results spatio-temporal
parts:
Hi, I am using inla to map standardizaed mortality ratios (SMRs). My question is how can I save the results for use in another analysis? In my example y are the observed cases, and E are the expected. Thank you


form1 <- y ~ 1 + f(area,model="bym",graph=map.adj) + f(area1,year,model="iid")+year
result1 <- inla(formula.par,family="poisson",data=data,E=E,control.predictor=list(compute=TRUE), control.compute=list(dic=TRUE, cpo=TRUE))

parts:
The most common approach is to use ?save.image, or save(result1, ...)

Is this what you mean?

PS: Be careful that everything you do uses different variable names if you load one .Rdata file into another script.

Best,
Haakon
